conditional_files.report.pdf: Only if PDF rendering finishes; missing/partial render remains a reported operational gap.
conditional_files.report.svg: Created after full report inputs/plot; may remain if PDF fails.

large_file_storage.ordering: Validate original source export/files before storage conversion; preserve exact original logical bytes, pull for later file checks as needed. Never rewrite original export links or scientific sealed-run data.

native_report.directory_rule: experiments/EXP-ECDLP-956f81/reports/run-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ>/ from actual first-trial start UTC in retained supervisor receipt; never choose a future timestamp or reuse a prior directory.
fixed_index_fields: actual first-trial timestamp and immutable timestamp source path/hash

native_report.no_new_report_for: Launch refused before any run directory exists; otherwise failed/timed-out runs are covered.
native_report.publication_order: Raw run snapshot committed/pushed first, native report second; postrun owner depends on run snapshot.
native_report.required: Fresh write-once report source, at least one graph/diagram plus local drawing script/data, inspected report.pdf; exact actual paths indexed after creation.

timestamp_source.format: Parse actual timezone-aware value, convert UTC, format %Y%m%dT%H%MZ; never use planning/current/future clock as replacement.
timestamp_source.missing_rule: If no retained actual first-trial start exists, record missing timestamp as a report-path blocker; do not invent a run directory timestamp.

operational_crash_rule: Retain every actual byte plus exception/returncode; no filename is claimed emitted when an import/I/O/renderer failure prevented it. Custody index reports each expected file present/absent with actual reason; it never fills missing observations.

postrun_index_contract.enumeration: Walk only assigned output scopes after producer termination; include every actual regular output, reject symlink/escape/duplicate logical path; exact directory-to-index completeness is a mandatory archive gate.
